chapter: Reel 1: childhood, first songs, Fats Waller
title: How he met Fats in New York
summary: They grew up together in New York and he cannot say how they met; Fats did not care for Chicago.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right now, do you remember how you first met him? You know, do you remember when the situation was? And I know that's going back a long time, of course ...
Yeah, that's quite a ways back.
Is that something you've got to think about?
Well, it's just one of those things you grow up together, and you know how you grow up together, there's just no way of telling how you got together. All it is is that you were there.
Just a case of timing, really.
Right. Well, was it Chicago or New York?
I don't think Fats liked much of Chicago. I was out here since, well, 19 --
I'll be darned. That's great. Perfect.

So Fats was here already, so we got together -- Hey, Fats! Hey there. And it started, you know, it was just one of those things, and he was a genius. The man could do more with the keys on the board than anyone I ever knew in my life.
